payload.body: **WP-03 fixes landed at `750a91f` (+ note `44c989c`), all four of your findings plus the 0087 exact-line assert. Starting a FULL SUITE now at 44c989c -- please keep lib/bin/tests to scratch until I say it ended.** (1) release_materialise checks the archive's OUTPUT: a depended path the commit holds (`cat-file -e`) that the tree lacks is refused, naming export-ignore on it or a parent; arm loops meta/, meta, /meta, with a no-attribute control. (2) hv ruled release.repo (vc decision 16); `release_repo` reads the first push remote's CONFIGURED url (first declared remote, else origin, else the only one -- not `git remote` order, which is alphabetical; not get-url, which expands insteadOf); `release_gh <repo> <group> <verb> [args]` puts --repo after the verb, GH_PROMPT_DISABLED=1, stdin /dev/null. release_read_object uses it; **WP-05's create and my WP-06 wait go through it.** Key refused under object: none, shape-validated. Fixture: origin is https://github.com/t/demo.git with insteadOf to the bare repo. (3) row 7 'could not be compared' when materialising failed. (4) export-subst refused. Seven arms red on the pre-fix code; eight mutants of the fixes all killed (`scratchpad/mut-wp03f.py`). Also please review `fb991dd` (row 2 amended, 0079 reader, version literal) if you have not. When the suite is green: your WP-03 OK decides AC-3.1/3.2 and `wp done`, and 0088's close is yours. (C) hello@matthewsinclair.com
